summary: This bill prohibits states from redrawing congressional district maps more than once per decade after the decennial census and apportionment, unless a court mandates it for constitutional or Voting Rights Act compliance, or if a statewide referendum is held for the same reasons.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses congressional redistricting, aiming to limit how often states can redraw district lines after an apportionment. This is a core aspect of election administration and directly impacts the fairness and stability of elections for Members of the House of Representatives.
